items.title: Ernest McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: a white bass player, Sherwood Manson, and Hank.

ctx.x: No, he really plays left over right. He's the honest one I know that plays left over right.

But keeps the string up the same way. Mm-hmm. I know a bass player that does that too, a white bass player, Sherwood Manson, and Hank. He keeps his tune. He can play your bass, but he plays it left hand. Looks fun.
Yeah, thank you for showing us those photos.
